places: Throne Day (accession of King MOHAMMED VI to the throne)

fields.climate: Mediterranean in the north, becoming more extreme in the interior; in the south, hot, dry desert; rain is rare; cold offshore air currents produce fog and heavy dew
fields.terrain: mountainous northern coast (Rif Mountains) and interior (Atlas Mountains) bordered by large plateaus with intermontane valleys, and fertile coastal plains…
fields.hazards: in the north, the mountains are geologically unstable and subject to earthquakes; periodic droughts; windstorms; flash floods; landslides; in the south, a hot, dry, dust/sand-laden sirocco wind can occur during winter and spring…
fields.resources: phosphates, iron ore, manganese, lead, zinc, fish, salt
fields.farm: wheat, milk, potatoes, sugar beets, tomatoes, barley, olives, apples, tangerines/mandarins, onions
fields.exports: fertilizers, cars, garments, insulated wire, tomatoes
fields.industries: automotive parts, phosphate mining and processing, aerospace, food processing, leather goods, textiles, construction, energy, tourism
fields.languages: Arabic (official), Tamazight languages (Tamazight (official), Tachelhit, Tarifit), French (often the language of business, government, and diplomacy)
fields.religions: Muslim 99% (official; virtually all Sunni, <0.1% Shia), other 1% (includes Christian, Jewish, and Baha'i); note - Jewish about 3,000-3,500
fields.legal: mixed system of civil law based on French civil law and Islamic (sharia) law; Constitutional Court reviews legislative acts

holiday.name: Throne Day (accession of King MOHAMMED VI to the throne)

fields.military: 19-25 years of age for 12-month compulsory and voluntary military service for men and women
